subject: Consolidated invoicing for EU subsidiaries & VAT setup
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated invoicing for EU subsidiaries & VAT setup

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We’re starting to centralize billing for our EU entities and I wanted to confirm how Redwood supports consolidated invoicing across multiple legal entities. A few specific questions: 

- Can Redwood issue a single consolidated monthly invoice to our parent company while listing per-entity lines (legal name + VAT ID) for accounting? Or do you require a separate invoice per legal entity?
- For EU VAT compliance, will Redwood include VAT IDs, tax amounts per line, and a reverse-charge indicator when applicable?
- Do you offer automated delivery to our AP system (SFTP/API) or only email/portal PDF delivery?

Our AP team prefers email copies to accounts.payable@acmehealth.com and a portal for retrieval, but we can be flexible. I’ve attached our current VAT certificate for the parent company — feel free to tell us what additional info you need.

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Finance Operations
Acme Health Systems
Attachment: Acme_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf (pdf, 320KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated invoicing for EU subsidiaries & VAT setup

Hi Emily — thanks for the context and the attachment. Short answers up front: yes, we can do consolidated monthly billing with per-entity line items, and we can include VAT IDs and tax breakdowns. We also support both email delivery and a customer portal; for higher-automation needs we offer SFTP/automated pushes as well.

A few items we need to proceed:
- The legal entity list you want represented on the invoice (exact registered names and VAT IDs).
- The primary billing recipient (parent entity) and the AP contact(s) for email delivery + portal admin user.
- Any PO/PO-number formatting requirements so we can include them on line items.

Cc'ing Marissa from Billing to outline the invoice format and delivery options, and Sean for procurement/payment terms. Once we have the entity list and AP contact, we’ll send a draft invoice template and a test file via the portal.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated invoicing for EU subsidiaries & VAT setup

Hi Emily — looping in with the operational details. We can produce one consolidated PDF per month addressed to the parent company and include a per-entity breakdown (legal name, VAT ID, invoice line with net, tax, and gross). Two delivery patterns we typically offer: 

1) Email + PDF: We send the consolidated invoice to the parent AP email (accounts.payable@acmehealth.com) and Bcc configured internal contacts.
2) Portal + Push: We post PDFs to the customer portal (secure), with optional SFTP push of a CSV/JSON line-item export for your ERP.

To ensure EU VAT compliance we need the following fields for each legal entity: registered_legal_name, registered_address (country), VAT_id, tax_rate, net_amount, tax_amount, invoice_number, invoice_date, and a reverse_charge flag if applicable. I attached our consolidated invoice template (spreadsheet) so you can see the column mapping.

If you prefer consolidated billing to the parent, we will still require the VAT IDs for each subsidiary to appear on the invoice for your local tax records. If any entity operates under a special tax regime, mark that in the spreadsheet.

Next steps:
- Emily: send the completed template with the legal names + VAT IDs + desired PO number format.
- We’ll generate one draft invoice and share via portal for sign-off.

Attachment: consolidated_invoicing_template.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated invoicing for EU subsidiaries & VAT setup

Thanks, Marissa — this is exactly what we need. Per your template, I’ve attached the filled-in entity sheet (see attachment) and confirmed our AP contact below:

AP contact for invoice delivery and portal admin:
- Maya Patel (Accounts Payable Manager)
- accounts.payable@acmehealth.com
- +44 20 5555 1234

We prefer: consolidated monthly invoice sent to accounts.payable@acmehealth.com plus portal access for Maya. For payment, our standard is bank transfer (wire) with a monthly remittance file; please include a remittance reference field on the invoice.

A couple of clarifying items: 
- For reverse charge: most of our inter-company buys will require a reverse-charge indicator rather than charging VAT on the Redwood side. Can you add a column in the export for reverse_charge = true/false?
- For tax point/date: we need invoice_date to align to the last day of the billing period.

I’ve attached our filled entity list and the parent VAT certificate again for records.

Thanks,
Emily
Attachment: acme_entity_list_filled.xlsx (xlsx, 14KB); Acme_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf (pdf, 320KB)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Consolidated invoicing for EU subsidiaries & VAT setup

Hi Emily — quick note from procurement/billing side. We can support bank transfer remittance and include a remittance reference field for your ERP. A few operational items to confirm so we can spin up the consolidated feed this month: 

- Confirm final list of legal entity names + VAT IDs (Emily provided — thank you).
- Confirm whether you want separate invoice_number sequences per legal entity or one master invoice_number and line references (we recommend a master invoice number with per-line legal_entity_reference for simplicity).
- We will create a portal user for Maya and send invite + test credentials to accounts.payable@acmehealth.com.

I’ll also send a short billing addendum for signature (DocuSign link below) that covers the consolidated invoicing terms and delivery options. Once signed, we’ll generate a draft invoice for April and push it to the portal for your review.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/XYZ-ACME-billing-addendum

If that all looks good, Marissa will generate the draft and Rishi will coordinate the client-side signoff.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
